manifest_data.name: Line speed
manifest_data.description: Tests your internet download speed once a night, outside download hours, and keeps a week of results.
manifest_data.author: TheMightyTRexUK

groups: Reaches Starboard on any network: with Starboard 0.23.0 or later it calls Starboard through a socket in its own folder, so it works on its own closed network too. An older Starboard works as before.
Clearer words: Test now asks "Download a test file now? It uses some of any data allowance." Before the first test, the band says Scheduled and the card says when the next test is.
Logo description: where its logo stands on its own, a screen reader says "Line speed logo", the plug-in's name, instead of a description of the symbol.
Shared helper: the helper every example shares sends Jellyfin's key the way Jellyfin 12 asks for it. This plug-in does not ask Jellyfin anything, so it works as before.
Lighter at rest: it wakes about once a minute while nothing asks it anything, not twice a second, and writes nothing to its folder when a run goes well.
Starts faster: its image comes with Python's modules already compiled, so a start takes about a quarter of the processor time.
A logo in Settings, Plug-ins, in the Catalogue and on its dashboard cards.
Its cards say how things are: a status and when they last changed, in the grey band at the top of each card.
Updates safely: before an update it finishes what it is doing and starts nothing new.
Needs Starboard with plug-in API 1.14 or later. A Starboard with an older plug-in API keeps version 1.0.0.
Tests your internet download speed once a night, outside download hours, and keeps a week of results.
